tasks.title: Guard src_priorities.py SHARES against drift from relay limits.json shares
tasks.why: src_priorities.py:34-35 retypes the relay's day shares as SHARES = dict(finish=60, fix=25, critique=15) and QUEUE_PRIORITY = 50, commented 'as it stood 2026-10-12' and 'limits.json queue_priority'. They still match Tools/relay/limits.json today (share_finish 60, share_fix 25, share_critique 15, queue_priority 50), but no test reads limits.json and compares: the relay can change its shares and the priority page keeps showing the old split with nothing red to catch it. test_priorities.py never mentions limits.json or SHARES.
tasks.done_when: a test_priorities.py case loads Tools/relay/limits.json and fails if share_finish/share_fix/share_critique/queue_priority differ from src_priorities.py's SHARES/QUEUE_PRIORITY

tasks.title: Fix src_priorities.py's wrong pointer to AREAS and area_of in relay sources
tasks.why: src_priorities.py:37 says the AREAS table is 'the area of the game a unit counts under (Tools/relay/sources/__init__.py AREAS, area_of)', but Tools/relay/sources/__init__.py has no AREAS constant and no area_of function anywhere in the file (grep confirms only kind_of is there, matching the other citation on line 93). An agent told to check or update AREAS against 'the source of truth' opens a file that does not have it and either gives up or edits the wrong place.
tasks.done_when: the comment on src_priorities.py:37 names where AREAS actually comes from (or says it is this file's own table, kept by hand), and grepping AREAS in Tools/relay/sources/ no longer contradicts the comment
